column1: # Consumption ledger for the schema-8 candidate families.
# Presence in a conformance root is not evidence that anything read it, and a
# green lane is not evidence that a named case still runs. This table names the
# cases the candidate lane must OBSERVE PASSING on each runner, and
# `.github/scripts/candidate_consumption.py gate` enforces it against the real
#   * a row listing this platform in `must_run_on` must be observed passing. A
#     rename, a deletion, a selection matching nothing, a module-level skip or
#     an unset conformance root fails here BY NAME instead of quietly shrinking
#   * a row names a test function and covers every parameterization it
#     produces, so a family that stops generating cases fails as loudly as a
# `.github/ci/candidate-artifacts.tsv` answers the other half: whether the root
# `must_run_on` takes a comma separated subset of {linux,darwin,windows}.

column3: the presence ledger is decided against the candidate manifest inside the run that consumes it
every published agent-skill-v8 and csk-skill-v8 case is collected, and neither family is empty
every published schema-8 manifest case decides acceptance through the real skill-spec loader
every published install-marker-v4 case is collected, and the family is not empty
every published install-marker-v4 case is read back through the marker reader and round-trips
every section of the published module-roots family is classified, so a new one cannot be ignored
every published module-roots case drives the go-v1 driver to its own declared failure boundary
every section of the published script-worker family is classified and every declared gap names its owning story, so neither a new section nor an orphaned gap can be ignored
the closed policy identity and interpreter set this build hard-codes are the suite's own
every published opt-in case decides manifest acceptance and the enforced/declared-only classification
every enforced shape the suite declares is refused with script_execution_policy_unsupported before any install mutation
